name: CHAPSPaymentSettled
trigger: Bank of England RTGS (RT2) confirms settlement of the CHAPS payment. SVC-009 updates CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052) submission_status to settled, records settled_at. Settlement is irrevocable — this event cannot be reversed. Published as the definitive settlement fact.
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for account debit. Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-001 boundary. Settlement fact also triggers MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed (EVT-112) publication.

payload_schema.uetr: string — ISO 20022 UETR (for customer reference and tracing)
payload_schema.rtgs_message_reference: string — Bank of England RTGS message ID
payload_schema.settled_at: string (ISO 8601 UTC) — definitive settlement timestamp from RTGS

excluded_fields.note: Excluded from settlement event — not required by consumers; sensitive fields minimised per event payload principles

consumers.action: Debits Account (ENT-004) by amount_gbp. Updates Account.chaps_daily_total. Updates CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) status to completed. Triggers customer notification via SVC-053.
Creates immutable settlement audit record with UETR and RTGS reference. Financial crime monitoring — settlement of high-value payment.

ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id + chaps_execution_id. Always follows EVT-110 for the same intent. SVC-001 consumer is idempotent on chaps_execution_id — duplicate settlement events produce no duplicate debits.
worm_rationale: Irrevocable settlement fact. Financial record required for reconciliation, regulatory reporting, and Consumer Duty evidence. CHAPS data quality audit by Bank of England. 7-year retention.
